reason: Freeze implementation details that are determined by response-free source code, bounded headers, non-response covariates and the already frozen comparator classes before y.wide.dryad.csv is opened.

wide_array_mapping.mapping: three visits nested within each of 15 years, in year order 2003-2017
wide_array_mapping.source_code_discrepancy: the archived demonstration R script selects columns 2:45 and then reshapes to 47x3x15, which would omit V45 and recycle values under R array semantics
wide_array_mapping.frozen_correction: use all 45 published visit columns exactly once; do not reproduce the apparent demonstration-script indexing error

first_detection_risk_set.surveyed_year: at least one finite 0/1 response visit
first_detection_risk_set.negative: at least one finite visit and all finite visits equal 0
first_detection_risk_set.after_first_detection: site leaves the first-detection risk set
first_detection_risk_set.destroyed_sites: indices 10,19,31 excluded from 2010 onward; any positive detection after destruction is a response-schema error
first_detection_risk_set.invalid_values: any finite response outside {0,1} stops the run

survey_covariates.visit_count: number of finite response visits in that site-year
survey_covariates.wind_temperature_means: mean over visits that are both surveyed and have finite covariate values
survey_covariates.fallback: if a surveyed row has no finite value for one covariate, use that covariate's response-free calibration-period global median
survey_covariates.calibration_scaling: all supervised-model means/SDs and imputation constants use calibration years only

rule_update_order.prediction_features: computed from worlds surviving before the current year's response
rule_update_order.calibration_update: after each calibration year's positive first detections, incompatible frozen rules are eliminated
rule_update_order.heldout_update: after scoring each heldout year, that year's positive first detections may eliminate rules for later years
rule_update_order.universe_falsification: if no rule survives before all heldout years are scored, preserve partial evidence and mark the primary endpoint non-estimable

dynamic_occupancy_hmm.state_space: two-state latent occupancy at the 47 surveyed sites
dynamic_occupancy_hmm.destroyed_site_years: latent occupancy forced to zero from 2010 onward
dynamic_occupancy_hmm.fit: deterministic bounded L-BFGS-B maximum likelihood with zero start plus four fixed-seed normal starts; at least one converged finite solution required
dynamic_occupancy_hmm.heldout_prediction: one-year-ahead probability of at least one recorded detection, using the filtered occupancy state through the preceding year and the frozen detection covariates; state filtering updates after each heldout response

decision_effect_of_missing_hmm: Layer-B versus same-world mean-only remains estimable if its own gates pass, but the external-added-value endpoint is non-estimable if the HMM cannot be fit under the frozen specification.
